title: On the Metro North
content: I got lucky this time. The guy sitting across from me on the train to New York yesterday spent most of the ride looking at his cellphone.The sketch is mostly done inwatercolor, in aPentalic watercolor sketchbook, with a few touches ofgouache,water-soluble colored pencils, andfountain pen with brown ink. Links take you to Amazon pages for more info.You can see a brief video clip, and hear the sounds of the train, if you visit my stream onInstagram,Facebook, orTwitter. I demonstrate a variety of watercolor techniques on my tutorialWatercolor in the Wild.
